versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "引流裂变" (viral-growth) skill.

- Provides actionable guidelines and SOPs for viral growth initiatives.
- Covers goal setting, SOP formulation, data integration, small-scale pilots, iterative optimization, and knowledge base updates.
- Establishes structured main and safeguarding metrics with clear definitions and reporting frequency.
- Includes compliance guidance for Chinese regulations and personal data protection.
- Offers reusable templates, scripts, checklists, and reporting/meeting note structures.
